news.title: Education library hosting free summer reading program
news.summary_en: A free summer reading program at the Education Library is free to all and includes prizes and a free book for participants. Readers will explore a variety of art mediums, including drawing, book illustration, painting, photography, sculpture, ceramics, textiles and fiber arts, and dance.

news.title: Faculty earn promotions and tenure
news.summary_en: Seven faculty members from the IU School of Education have been promoted. The promotions were approved by the IU Board of Trustees at their June meeting and are effective as of July 1, 2026.
